**Full Time - Permanent**

We're looking for an Applied Marketing AI Engineer to join an innovative team exploring the next generation of AI-powered marketing technology, with a particular focus on generative image and video applications.

* Developing and iterating on proofs of concept (POCs) to explore new applications of generative AI across marketing and content workflows.
* Building evaluation frameworks that measure, assess and continuously improve AI-generated outputs.
* Experimenting with AI-generated imagery and video, exploring ways to improve visual quality, realism and consistency.
* Developing techniques to generate marketing and brand assets that align with specific brand identities, visual styles and guidelines.
* Exploring LLMs, multimodal models and agentic AI to solve complex marketing challenges and unlock new product capabilities.
* Taking ideas from initial experimentation through to functional prototypes, evaluating their potential for wider product adoption.

**What We're Looking For**

* Strong hands-on experience developing and applying LLMs and Generative AI in practical applications.
* Strong foundations in software engineering, backend development, machine learning or AI systems.
* Excellent quantitative and probabilistic thinking, with an analytical and experimental approach to problem-solving.
* Experience building, testing and evaluating AI-powered applications, ideally involving agentic systems or autonomous workflows.
* A creative and experimental mindset, with the ability to challenge conventional approaches and explore new possibilities.
* Strong product intuition and an ability to connect technical innovation with real-world customer and commercial applications.
* Experience with image generation, video generation, computer vision or multimodal AI would be particularly valuable.

Technical Experience

* **Languages & Backend:**
  Python, SQL, JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js and API development.
* **LLMs & Agentic AI:**
  OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, LangChain, LangGraph and LlamaIndex.
* **Image & Video Generation:**
  Diffusion models, Stable Diffusion, Hugging Face, ComfyUI and multimodal AI.

  Model evaluation, benchmarking, experimentation and automated quality assessment.
* **Data & Infrastructure:**
  RAG, embeddings, vector databases, PostgreSQL, Redis, AWS/Azure/GCP, Docker and Kubernetes.
